basic atk.name: Order: Flare Propulsion
basic atk.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of SAM's ATK to one designate enemy.

enhanced basic atk.name: Fyrefly Type-!V: Pyrogenic Decimation
enhanced basic atk.description: Restores HP by an amount equal to 20% of this unit's Max HP. Deals Fire DMG equal to {atk_scaling}% of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Order: Aerial Bombardment
skill.description: Consumes HP equal to 40% of this unit's Max HP and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to {energy_scaling}% of this unit's Max Energy. Deals Fire DMG equal to {attack_scaling}% of SAM's ATK to a single target enemy. If the current HP is not sufficient, reduces SAM's HP to 1 when using this Skill. Advances this unit's next Action by 25%.

enhanced skill.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Deathstar Overload
enhanced skill.description: Restores HP by an amount equal to 25% of this unit's Max HP. Applies Fire Weakness to a single target enemy, lasting for 2 turn(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (0.2 × Break Effect + {scaling_1}%) of SAM's ATK to this target. At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to (0.1 × Break Effect + {scaling_2}%) of SAM's ATK to adjacent targets. The Break Effect taken into the calculation is capped at 360%.

ultimate.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Complete Combustion
ultimate.description:
Enters the Complete Combustion state, advances this unit's Action by 100%, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Skill. While in Complete Combustion, increases SPD by {spd_scaling}, and when using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases this unit's Weakness Break Efficiency by 50% and the Break DMG dealt by SAM to the enemy targets by 10%—22%, lasting until this current attack ends.
A countdown timer for the Complete Combustion state appears on the Action Order. When the countdown timer's turn starts, SAM exits the Complete Combustion state. The countdown timer has a fixed SPD of 70.
SAM cannot use Ultimate while in Complete Combustion.

talent.name: Chrysalid Pyronexus
talent.description:
The lower the HP, the less DMG received. When HP is 20% or lower, the DMG Reduction reaches its maximum effect, reducing up to {dmg_reduction}%. During the Complete Combustion, the DMG Reduction remains at its maximum effect, and the Effect RES increases by {eff_res_scaling}%.
If Energy is lower than 50% when the battle starts, regenerates Energy to 50%. Once Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all debuffs on this unit.

technique.name: Δ Order: Meteoric Incineration
technique.description: Leaps into the air and moves about freely for 5 seconds, which can be ended early by launching a plunging attack. When the duration ends, plunges and immediately attacks all enemies within a set area. At the start of each wave, applies a Fire Weakness to all enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to 200% of SAM's ATK to all enemies.

a2.name: Module α: Antilag Outburst
a2.description: During the Complete Combustion, attacking enemies that have no Fire Weakness can also reduce their Toughness, with the effect being equivalent to 55% of the original Toughness Reduction from abilities.

a4.name: Module β: Autoreactive Armor
a4.description: When SAM is in Complete Combustion with a Break Effect that is equal to or greater than 200%/360%, attacking a Weakness-Broken enemy target will convert the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of 35%/50% Super Break DMG.

a6.name: Module γ: Core Overload
a6.description: For every 10 point(s) of SAM's ATK that exceeds 1800, increases this unit's Break Effect by 0.8%.

Eidolons.name: In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest
Eidolons.description: When using the Enhanced Skill, ignores 15% of the target's DEF. The Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points.

Eidolons.name: From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall
Eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, using the Enhanced Basic ATK or the Enhanced Skill to defeat an enemy target or to Break their Weakness allows SAM to immediately gain 1 extra turn. This effect can only trigger 1 time per turn, and the trigger count resets at the start of SAM's turn.

Eidolons.name: Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep
Eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Eidolons.name: Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze
Eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Effect RES by 50%.

Eidolons.name: From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine
Eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

Eidolons.name: In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom
Eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Fire RES PEN by 20%. When using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%.
